fusions.name: Snare Burst
fusions.desc: Deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1 second. Each hit also has a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spun Thread
fusions.desc: A thrown thread that deals 7 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Skittering Brood
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 12 seconds that stings an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Silk Sentry
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of silk that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage. It also applies [Slowed] for 3 seconds.
